meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: 它接手v1→v2迁移收尾：先核对是否已运行迁移脚本，再让v2能收发真实消息，设置拥有者账号，迁移旧记忆，检查容器配置，并帮你移植自定义代码。
howto.when: 当你提到“migrate from v1”、“finish migration”等，或要求完成v2迁移时触发；前提是已运行`bash migrate-v2.sh`。

say.note: 它会检查迁移脚本是否已跑，然后开始收尾。

say.text: 把我设为这个机器人的拥有者
say.note: 它会查询用户列表并给你分配owner角色。
它会为已导入的群组运行/migrate-memory。

howto.what_en: It finishes a v1→v2 migration: verifies the migration script ran, confirms v2 routes real messages, seeds the owner account, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom code.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", or similar requests to complete a v2 migration, provided `bash migrate-v2.sh` has already run.

say_en.text: Finish my v1 to v2 migration.
say_en.note: It checks if the migration script ran, then starts.

say_en.text: Make me the owner of this bot.
say_en.note: Queries users and grants you the owner role.
